depiction.primary_object: three vertical wavy rising lines representing heat or steam
depiction.composition: three parallel vertical S-curves with an exclamation mark to the top right

readings.meaning: overheating warning or high heat alert
heating system fault or radiator error
smoke, fumes, or bad odor alert

ambiguity: Without a container or appliance beneath the wavy lines, it can be read as heat, steam, smoke, smell, or even bacon strips at a quick glance.

modifier_semantics.meaning: warning, alert, fault, or urgent issue

task_intents: fix broken home heating or radiator

reasoning: Three vertical wavy lines paired with an exclamation mark represent a heat, steam, smoke, or odor warning. It fits troubleshooting tasks for overheating electronics, heating/HVAC faults, burning smells, or heatwave alerts, though without context the bare wavy lines are somewhat abstract.
